spec_source: GrowthIM v4 Universal Algorithm Spec — Batches 10-12

naics2.label: Mining, Quarrying, Oil & Gas Extraction
naics2.user_message: GrowthIM is designed for consumer-facing local businesses. Mining and extraction operations don't fit that pattern.

naics2.label: Utilities (regulated)
naics2.reason: Regulated utilities; not GrowthIM's customer base.
naics2.user_message: GrowthIM serves consumer-facing businesses. Regulated utilities have different industry dynamics.

naics2.label: Management of Companies & Enterprises
naics2.reason: Holding companies, regional HQs; not consumer-facing.
naics2.user_message: GrowthIM is built for businesses with customer touchpoints. Holding companies and corporate offices don't fit.

naics2.label: Public Administration
naics2.reason: Government agencies; not GrowthIM customers by design.
naics2.user_message: GrowthIM serves private-sector businesses. Government agencies have different operational frameworks.

naics6Patterns.label: Most manufacturing
naics6Patterns.reason: B2B production; consumer-facing exceptions only (retail bakery, brewery, winery, distillery).

naics6Patterns.label: Most information sub-sectors
naics6Patterns.reason: Software publishers, broadcasting, ISPs not local-discovery.

layer0Modes.rule: input length < 3 OR matches blocklist (out-of-scope NAICS-21/22/55/92 keyword)
input contains a known directory hostname
layer0Modes.downstream: fetch the listing directly via Google Places / Yelp APIs

layer0Modes.rule: input matches Google place_id pattern (ChIJ-prefix, 27 chars)
layer0Modes.downstream: direct dispatch to Google Places Details API

layer0Modes.rule: input is a 6-digit numeric NAICS code
input fuzzy-matches an entry in registry.chains (Levenshtein distance ≤ 2 OR substring match)
layer0Modes.downstream: set chain template flag; route to chain-specific report variant

layer0Modes.rule: input contains one or more keywords from registry.keywords
layer0Modes.downstream: route to NAICS-6 candidate. If multi-match → mode=ambiguous

layer0Modes.rule: input matches multiple keywords with different NAICS-6 parents AND no deterministic disambiguation rule
layer0Modes.downstream: trigger user-clarification prompt with the candidate list
geocode via Google + Nominatim fallback; classify via Google Places nearby

layer0Modes.rule: input has only ', <state-code>' pattern (no street number, no business type)
layer0Modes.downstream: city-level search; broader scope. Confidence: MEDIUM
free-form geocode; confidence: LOW; tag report 'auto-detected'

bakery.tiebreak: Default 311811. Shift to 722515 if 'cafe'/'coffee' present; 445291 if 'retail-only' framing.

studio.tiebreak: yoga/pilates → 611620; photo → 541921; design/architecture → 541490; recording/art → 711510. If no modifier, ask user.

spa.tiebreak: Default 812199. Shift to 721110 if 'retreat'/'overnight'. Shift to 621399 if 'medical'/'aesthetic medicine'.

shop.tiebreak: Always reject without modifier. Prompt: 'What kind of shop?'

agency.tiebreak: Modifier required. ad/marketing → 541810; travel → 561510; staffing/recruiting → 561311; HR → 541612.

services.tiebreak: Always reject without domain modifier. 'cleaning services' → 561720; 'legal services' → 5411*; 'IT services' → 541512.

group.tiebreak: 'medical group' → 621* by specialty; 'law group' → 5411* by area; 'consulting group' → 541611/541612.

boutique.tiebreak: Modifier required. 'hotel' → 721110. 'fitness'/'pilates'/'barre' → 713940. Default to clothing 458110 if no modifier.

house.tiebreak: If business-name only, route via Google Places type. Modifier required.

co.tiebreak: Strip and re-route to substantive noun. 'Plumbing Co' → 238220.

pro.tiebreak: Treat as marketing suffix; route to substantive noun.

key_recommendations.label: Channel mix audit
key_recommendations.body: Compare current acquisition spend vs S023. Aggregator (Angi/Thumbtack) target <10% of marketing budget. Google LSA + SEO are the dominant channels.

key_recommendations.label: Structured post-project feedback
key_recommendations.body: Implement milestone-triggered surveys per S021. Firms doing this see 15% higher margins and ~$1.8M referral revenue.

key_recommendations.label: Google Business Profile + LSA combo
key_recommendations.body: LSA close rate is 31% (S023). Combined with optimized GBP and SEO content, this is the highest-ROI channel stack.

key_recommendations.label: Referral velocity tracking
key_recommendations.body: Per S022 (Holt Homes case): structured CX programs lift referral share 25%→35%+ over 4 years. Track referral source at project intake.

key_recommendations.label: Hit the 43-review threshold
key_recommendations.body: Per S014: 43+ reviews → +26% revenue; 200+ reviews → +46%. Quarterly review cadence required (S011).

key_recommendations.label: Google-first review strategy
key_recommendations.body: Per S012: bad Google rating hits revenue 33%; Yelp 19%; Facebook 9%. Recovery resources go to Google.

key_recommendations.label: Optimum band: 3.5-4.5 stars
key_recommendations.body: 5.0-star establishments sometimes underperform 4.5-star (skepticism). Don't chase perfect.

key_recommendations.label: Repeat-customer focus
key_recommendations.body: Per S017: 5pp retention lift → 25-95% profit lift. Loyalty programs and SMS reactivation are highest-leverage actions.

key_recommendations.label: Multi-platform review presence
key_recommendations.body: Per S027: 82% of legal clients seek reviews; 50.6% highly influenced. Google + Avvo + 1 more platform required.

key_recommendations.label: Structured referral program
key_recommendations.body: Per S028: referred clients = 16% more profit, 37% retention, 30% conversion. Each referral generates 2.68 follow-ons.

key_recommendations.label: Practice-area content marketing
key_recommendations.body: Per S029: review influence is HIGHER in legal/medical/financial than retail. Educational content builds referral-converting credibility.

key_recommendations.label: Multi-platform review presence
key_recommendations.body: Per S024: consumers use Google + Healthgrades + Vitals + Zocdoc. Healthcare needs more platforms than retail.

key_recommendations.label: Fix admin before clinical
key_recommendations.body: Per S026: ~80% of dental complaints are admin (phone, scheduling), not clinical. Admin improvements are higher-ROI than clinical changes.

key_recommendations.label: Insurance accepted = trust signal
key_recommendations.body: Per S024: ~90% of patients rate insurance-list importance high. Make insurance coverage explicit on GBP and website.

key_recommendations.label: Volume + recency on reviews
key_recommendations.body: Womply S010-S011 patterns apply. Note: review responses must be HIPAA-compliant (don't acknowledge specific patient details).

key_recommendations.label: Channel mix is THE marketing decision
key_recommendations.body: Per S030: 8x CAC spread across channels. Aggregator spend should be <10% of budget.

key_recommendations.label: Word-of-mouth amplification
key_recommendations.body: Per S031: 60-70% of new clients in cleaning/landscaping/pest control come from word-of-mouth. Reviews are referral-amplification, not standalone marketing.

key_recommendations.label: Google Business Profile + LSA combo
key_recommendations.body: Per S023: LSAs deliver 31% close rate. Combined with maintained GBP and SEO service pages, this is the dominant channel stack.

key_recommendations.label: Response-time SLA
key_recommendations.body: Industry benchmark: <5 min response = 5x more likely to win the lead than >1 hour. Speed matters as much as price.

key_recommendations.label: Auto repair: track 12-month retention as primary KPI
key_recommendations.body: Per S032: industry baseline is 40-50% retention. NADA target 72%+. Most independents are below this.

key_recommendations.label: Salon: 24/7 online booking is the retention lever
key_recommendations.body: Per S033: online-bookers return 78% vs walk-ins 39%. 46% of bookings happen outside business hours. Caveat: causal incremental lift ~1.3-1.5x, not 2x (selection effects).

key_recommendations.label: Neutral experience = non-return
key_recommendations.body: Per S032: largest driver of customer non-return is a NEUTRAL service experience. 'Wow' moments lift neutral→positive at low cost.

key_recommendations.label: 0.1-star elasticity at brick-and-mortar
key_recommendations.body: Per S016: 0.1-star Google rating increase ~25% conversion lift. Sharpest in 3.5-4.5 band.

key_recommendations.label: Reviews drive 50-70% of discovery
key_recommendations.body: Per S034 and S035: experiential entertainment 70%+ review-driven; golf and bowling ~50%. Review-management is the dominant marketing channel.

key_recommendations.label: Channel-specific apps for category leaders
key_recommendations.body: Per S035: tee-time booking apps (GolfNow), bowling-league platforms add 20-30% of new customers.

key_recommendations.label: Photos and video drive booking conversion
key_recommendations.body: For experiential entertainment, the booking decision happens after visualizing the experience. Image quality measurably moves bookings.

key_recommendations.label: Group-booking optimization
key_recommendations.body: Recreation venues earn outsized revenue from group bookings (corporate events, birthdays, league nights). Dedicated landing page + email capture lifts this channel.
